rows.expected_answer: Blaidd là chiến binh nửa sói, đồng thời là shadow trung thành phục vụ Ranni the Witch.

response.answer: Blaidd the Half-Wolf là một NPC chiến binh nửa sói, phục vụ Công chúa Mặt Trăng Ranni với vai trò "bóng" (shadow) trung thành của cô ấy [1]. Mô tả trang bị trong game cũng nói rõ Blaidd từng là bóng của Ranni và là đồng minh trung thành, sẵn sàng chống lại cả số phận nếu nó buộc anh phản bội chủ nhân [3]. Còn một chi tiết trong mô tả giáp gọi anh là "thanh gươm của Ranni" — cùng ý nghĩa: anh là người thi hành ý chí và bảo vệ cho cô ấy [5].

payload.title: War Counselor Iji
payload.text:
A good-natured troll who once served the Carian Royal Family as a blacksmith. Currently, Iji serves Ranni, the Carian princess, as her war counsellor, while still plying his trade as a blacksmith outside the Kingsrealm Ruins, near the Caria Manor.
Iji has known Ranni and Blaidd since they were children, and they would let him join in when they played. Along with Blaidd, he swore allegiance to Ranni when she renounced her flesh and chose the dark path of the Empyrean. Iji is also shown to care for Blaidd, however he also harbours some reservations. Fearing that, as her sworn shadow, Blaidd will go mad and become a curse for Ranni for resisting the Two Fingers, Iji imprisons Blaidd in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol.
Iji became acquainted with Jerren when he was a guest of the Carians. Jerren recalls that the weapons Iji smithed were blunt, yet did not decay when faced with Scarlet Rot. Jerren may also offer a vital clue regarding Ranni's fate, which helps Iji to come to the realisation that General Radahn must be killed in order to release the stars and Ranni's own fate.
Later, after Blaidd breaks free of his imprisonment and gives his life in defence of Ranni, Iji admits that he misjudged Blaidd's loyalty, and senses that he will soon join Blaidd in death. Later, he can be found dead, his body ablaze with black flame, with the corpses of Black Knife Assassins nearby.

rows.expected_answer: Marika giao cho Maliketh phong ấn và canh giữ Rune of Death, còn gọi là Destined Death.

response.answer: Marika giao cho Maliketh phong ấn Rune of Death (Destined Death) — ông giữ nó trong chính thanh kiếm của mình [1][3]. Việc cất đi Rune of Death khỏi Elden Ring chính là bước đặt nền móng cho Golden Order, với Marika là vị thần duy nhất [1][3].

sources.title: Maliketh, the Black Blade
sources.text:
Maliketh is the loyal Shadowbound Beast and half-brother of Queen Marika the Eternal, an Empyrean of Numen descent, who would become the vessel of the Elden Ring.
Maliketh fought and defeated the Gloam-Eyed Queen, the leader of the Godskin Apostles. On Marika's orders, Maliketh sealed away the Rune of Death, binding it within his blade, causing the true power of the god-slaying black flame to be lost.
When the Rune of Death was plucked from the Elden Ring, and confined, the Golden Order was created, with Queen Marika as its one true god. Marika's offspring were granted a form of immortality owing to the removal of their fated deaths from the Elden Ring, however there was not one Demigod who did not fear Maliketh and his blade imbued with death. He was a beast of such terrifying ferocity that his name came to mean "Death of the Demigods". He also led the Black Blade Kindred, living gargoyles who wielded weapons held together by blackened corpse wax.

payload.title: Giants' Flame
payload.text:
Melina awakens the Giants' Flame
The fell god's Flame remained anathema to the Erdtree faith, and was a forbidden subject during Queen Marika's reign. Prophets who caught glimpses of the fated burning of the Erdtree were declared to be heretics and banished. However, the flame of ruin continued to smolder within the forge on the northern mountaintops, guarded by the Fire Monks and their Prelates. These stewards, entrusted with the Giantsflame, eventually succumbed to its allure, becoming its worshippers out of reverence and fear.
The secrets of the Giants' Flame were documented in a Giant's Prayerbook and kept hidden by the Prelates. Later, Adan stole the Flame of the Fell God from Chief Guardian Arghanthy, and Fire Monks crusaded as far as Liurnia to reclaim it.
In time, the Melina, or a potential Lord of Frenzied Flame, reached the forge atop Flame Peak. Harnessing the power of the flame of ruin, they ignited the Erdtree.

payload.title: Queen Marika the Eternal
payload.text:
Marika sent her son Messmer away on a crusade into the lands of the Hornsent. Despite her precautions, her fear of the Abyssal Serpent sealed within him led her to trap him within the Realm of Shadow, where he would wage war to exterminate the Hornsent and devastate their lands. No matter how many of her enemies burned in his flame, however, Messmer received no sign from Marika to end his crusade. To hide away these actions and the true nature of her godhood, Marika hid the Realm of Shadow behind a magical veil to obscure it from public knowledge.
After Godfrey's banishment from the Lands Between, Marika took Radagon as second husband and King Consort, elevating him to become the second Elden Lord. Radagon already had three children with Queen Rennala of the Carian Royal Family, and after his union with Marika, she would raise her new step-children, Radahn, Rykard and Ranni, to demigod status.
Marika and Radagon would go on to have two more children of their own, the twins Malenia and Miquella, who like Marika herself and Radagon's daughter Ranni, were Empyreans, and were thus potential successors to Marika. However, Radagon and Marika were in truth the same. Radagon was described as Marika's male "other self". Thus the twins were the children of a single god, and they were both born afflicted: Malenia with rotting sickness and Miquella with eternal childhood.

payload.title: Melina
payload.text:
Melina is accompanied by the spectral steed Torrent when they both spot an adrift Tarnished whom she believes is fortunate. Some time later, she decides to approach and offer an accord to the maidenless Tarnished: she could play the role of the missing Finger Maiden in return for a ride to the foot of the Erdtree. The Tarnished is forced to accept if they desire the strength of runes, and, if they accept the accord, Melina entrusts them with the Spectral Steed Whistle and, therefore, Torrent.
When Melina starts travelling with the Tarnished, she advises to follow the guidance of grace and seek the demigod residing within Stormveil Castle. Once the Tarnished has felled the demigod, Melina confesses that she was testing the Tarnished to see if they truly possessed the guidance of grace and if they were fit for the challenges to come. Satisfied with her new companion, Melina offers to take them to Roundtable Hold, a gathering place for Tarnished champions. Throughout their journey, Melina also provides specks of guidance at certain sites of grace and, at churches dedicated to Queen Marika, she offers to reveal words spoken by Marika herself in the distant past.
Upon arriving at their destination, the Royal Capital at the foot of the Erdtree, Melina thanks the Tarnished for escorting her and leaves to ascertain her purpose, claiming that she can govern her movement more freely there. She entrusts the power of runes and Torrent to the Tarnished. She will also offer her aid should the Tarnished challenge Morgott, the Omen King, ruler of Leyndell and guardian of the Erdtree.

sources.title: Scadutree Fragment
sources.text: A splinter of the Scadutree that contains golden brilliance. Acquired at the Church of Marika and other places in the realm of shadow. Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Scadutree Blessing. The Scadutree Blessing bolsters the bearer's ability to deal and negate damage but has no influence outside the realm of shadow. It is said that when the Scadutree crumbles from its core that it will scatter across the entire realm of shadow. The people of the Erdtree collect the splinters and use them in prayer.

payload.text:
The Scadutree is the shadow of the Erdtree, and it was born of dark notions that bear no sense of Order, that twist and bend its stock, rendering it brittle.
A piece of a
Scadutree Fragment
.
The Scadutree is holy but its gold is veiled in shadow and covered in impenetrable thorns. Due to its holiness the Scadutree is able to bless, although it has no influence outside of the Realm of Shadow. payload.title: Scarlet Rot
payload.text:
Scarlet rot is a corrupting force
Scarlet Rot is an old legend in the Lands Between, a dangerous sickness that eats away life like a vicious plague. It corrupts men and beasts who come into contact with it, deforming their bodies and eating away their wits, driving them to madness and causing them to act like wild animals. As such, Scarlet Rot is often fended off using fire.
The Empyrean and demigod, Malenia, Blade of Miquella harbored the affliction of Scarlet Rot within her body from birth, which has decayed her body and caused her to lose her limbs. Her will, pride, dignity, and sense of self, along with the help of her brother Miquella of the Haligtree's Unalloyed Gold Needle assisted with resisting the call of the Scarlet Rot. However, at the Battle of Aeonia, the final battle of the Shattering, she abandoned this pride to meet Starscourge Radahn's measure. This resulted in the blooming of the first flower of Aeonia causing both Caelid and Radahn to become blighted by the Scarlet Rot. Upon Malenia's return to Miquella's Haligtree, it too was infected and malformed by the Scarlet Rot. The Swamp of Aeonia spawned by the flower in Caelid gave rise to Kindred of Rot, also known as "Pests." Some inorganic beings are capable of contracting and hosting the disease; a number of Crystalians, and their weapons, fester with Scarlet Rot.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Bring the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, who will give you the Carian Inverted Statue. This key item is required for Fia's questline, however it is not necessary to complete Ranni's questline.
WARNING: This will immediately end Preceptor Seluvis's quest.
Ainsel River
Renna's Rise will now be open after giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the sending gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.
Pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point and rest at the Ainsel River Main Site of Grace. Use the "Talk to miniature Ranni" option three times to get her to speak.
(Optional) Ranni will also have dialogue at the Nokstella, Eternal City and Nokstella Waterfall Basin Sites of Grace. These are not required to continue her questline.
Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to obtain the Discarded Palace Key. Go to Rennala's boss room in Academy of Raya Lucaria and unlock the chest to obtain the Dark Moon Ring.
Moonlight Altar
Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void at the end of the Lake of Rot and travel up the lift. This lift only unlocks if you have obtained the Dark Moon Ring.
Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and descend through the tunnel near the altar to find Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers. Interact with her to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, speak to her again and she will disappear, leaving behind the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Leyndell, Ashen Capital
After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign on the Stone Platform. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending.

# Transient Moonlight | Elden Ring Wiki

Transient Moonlight is the unique Skill found on Moonveil, a Katana in Elden Ring. This skill allows the wielder of the Katana to assume a sheathed Iaido-style stance which is then followed up by two unique slashing attacks. The Light Attack triggers a wide horizontal slash (roughly 75º-90º directly in front of the player), releasing an arc-shaped magic projectile attack. The Heavy Attack triggers a vertical downward slash, also releasing a similar projectile attack. [...] This is a Unique Skill
 FP Cost: - (15 20)
 This Skill is not Chargeable
 This Skill's Light and Heavy attacks can be Parried
 Wearing Spellblade Set increases the damage
 Damage of the waves fired is 100% Magic Damage and is affected by Intelligence but not Dexterity or Strength
 This skill activates and benefits from Rellana's Cameo talisman.
 The Light Attack is excellent for crowd control against hoards of low-poise enemies.
 This Skill deals 5 or 7.5 Poise damage with the magic projectile depending on light or heavy attack. A direct hit from the Moonveil used to fire it will do an additional 22.5 using the Light Attack variant for a total of 27.5 Poise damage. The Heavy Attack variant deals an additional 22.5 with the Katana itself for a total of 30 Poise damage on a direct strike. [...] The projectiles take the form of a medium range (approx. half the range of a standard throwing knife) blue arc. They can be aimed freely, including up and down vertical control, a useful tool when dealing with large enemies with weak points above standard striking level, such as the heads of dragons. While Moonveil deals split physical (slashing) and magical damage, the beam released from this skill deals strictly magical damage.

sources.title: Moonveil
sources.text:
The Unique Skill: Transient Moonlight is the regular Skill: Unsheathe but with added projectiles: a short-ranged one for the light attack sweep and a mid-ranged one for the heavy attack overhead slash.
The skill is useful in roughly the same ways that Unsheathe is, meaning that the light attack follow-up is generally slightly quicker and much wider in exchange for being slightly weaker, while the heavy attack follow-up hits a single target slightly harder and is slightly more difficult to roll directly away from.
One stark difference is that the different attacks are much less dissimilar, with the light attack follow-up having less of a damage difference (22% less for Unsheathe, 10% less for Transient Moonlight) and much less of a Stance damage difference (50% less for Unsheathe, 8% less for Transient Moonlight).
While this does give the weapon some more reach (though mostly with the heavy attack follow-up), the skill is still the most effective at melee range since that means both the weapon and the magic waves can hit the target.
The skill's heavy attack follow-up has a weird interaction with jumping players and deals a lot less damage against them for some reason.
While a hybrid Intelligence/Dexterity build gains the highest total Attack Power a pure Intelligence build only loses about 2% total Attack Power in exchange for the skill's projectiles getting 13% higher Attack Power, making the latter generally preferable.

payload.title: Ivory Sickle
payload.text:
While the skill, Quickstep, is rather generic for an innate, locked skill, it's still very useful for quicker traversal on surfaces that slow you down, like deep muck or water, and for getting around in combat aggressively.
Due to this weapon's mild Intelligence requirement and light weight, it allows for exploiting the fact that Quickstep costs 0 FP if the weapon's requirements aren't met and 8 out of 10 Origins won't do so by default (only the Astrologer and Prisoner meet them). While this heavily limits the skill's in-combat usage (decreases amount of i-frames from 15 to 5) it does make it ideal for traveling over slowing surfaces.
Unusually for a weapon upgraded with Smithing Stones, this weapon cannot be buffed or have its affinity changed.
Though its Dexterity-scaling is slightly stronger than its Intelligence-scaling it gains the most Attack Power from a hybrid Dexterity/Intelligence approach.
Though the description may give the impression that this is a Faith-scaling weapon, it has not association with that stat.
Overall a somewhat awkward weapon when it comes to how to best use it. A pure Intelligence build would do better with any other dagger with a Magic affinity while a hybrid Dex/Int build would probably prefer the Glintstone Kris.
It does admittedly serve as a decent stand-in for the aforementioned Glintstone Kris before getting it since it requires defeating two specific bosses holding Great Runes while the Ivory Sickle can be gained without defeating any boss at all if Stormveil Castle is bypassed and is available a bit earlier than most Cold or Magic affinity Skills. It's also a decent off-hand weapon but is somewhat hampered by requiring the somewhat hard-to-get-enough-of regular Smithing Stones.

payload.text:
(Optional) Speak to D, Hunter of the Dead, after obtaining a Deathroot and he will advise you to visit Gurranq. This can either be done at the start of D's questline in Limgrave, or in Roundtable Hold.

payload.title: Melina
payload.text:
Melina's questline runs parallel to the main storyline and thus must be completed to finish the game.
Limgrave
Activate two different Sites of Grace in the open world and then sit at one of the following Graces: Agheel Lake North, Agheel Lake South, Bridge of Sacrifice, Church of Elleh, Gatefront Ruins, Seaside Ruins, Stormhill Shack, or Third Church of Marika. You will trigger the first interaction with Melina. She will offer you an accord, allowing you to continue her quest.
Agheel Lake North and Gatefront Ruins will always summon Melina, even if two other Sites of Grace haven't been activated.
If you refuse her accord, you cannot enter Leyndell, Royal Capital, even with two Great Runes. If you refuse, you may always change your mind by selecting "Talk to Melina" at any Site of Grace.
If you accept, you will obtain the Spectral Seed Whistle, allowing you to summon Torrent.
(Optional) After accepting her accord, Melina may appear when you rest at Sites of Grace to offer the dialogue options "The Rays of Grace" and "Melina's Goal". These options will no longer be available once you progress to the next step.
Anywhere
Rest at any Site of Grace outside Limgrave or fight Margit, the Fell Omen at least once to trigger another conversation in which Melina will invite you to Roundtable Hold. Accepting this invite is mandatory to access Leyndell, Royal Capital later in the game.
Leyndell, Royal Capital
Resting at a Site of Grace in Leyndell will trigger another interaction with Melina, after which she will leave you. Her dialogue options at various Sites of Grace will no longer be available until after you have defeated Morgott, Omen King.
(Optional) Melina may be summoned as a cooperator through her summon sign outside Morgott's boss room.

sources.title: Nokron, Eternal City | Elden Ring Wiki
sources.text:
At the top of the stairs and underneath the massive skeleton on its throne, you'll find a chest containing the Hidden Treasure of Nokron, the Fingerslayer Blade. If you are following Ranni the Witch questline, this is what you were looking for.

There is also a Great Ghost Glovewort. The waygate next to this giant statue will take you back up to the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace. [...] Head through the hallway to the east, ahead you'll find an imp statue next to a door that has to be unlocked with a Stonesword Key, inside of it you'll find a Nox Swordstress, a chest containing the Mimic Tear Ashes, and a Smithing Stone (3) "Smithing Stone (3)") on the right-side of the door when you enter. Coming out, turn back around facing the room with the Black Whetblade. The left side of the wall has three open windows. You want to jump out the first window on your left (if coming from the Imp Statue that takes the Stonesword Key). Jumping out of the other two windows will cause you to fall to your death, so if you're unsure, simply jump onto the ledge first, then check that it is safe to jump. [...] (Alternate route: From the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace, mount Torrent and hop onto the nearby rock. With this elevation, a carefully-placed double jump should be able to get you on the roof of the immediate building, as opposed to the intended path. From there, you can hop from roof to roof of the buildings. Once you enter the bounds of Night's Sacred Grounds, you can drop from roof to roof of the building, then land carefully on the edge of the wall, before dropping to your destination and collect the Fingerslayer Blade. Note that this route will skip all of the other loot detailed above.)

### The Rest of Nokron

sources.title: Fingerslayer Blade
sources.text:
The upper section of Nokron can only be reached from a crater near Fort Haight formed after the defeat of Starscourge Radahn.
As the chest can only be opened after selecting Serve Ranni the Witch after talking to her at Ranni's Rise, attempting to interact with it prior to this will prompt the message You are not destined to open this instead.

sources.title: Moonlight Altar
sources.text:
A plateau in the southwest of Liurnia, accessible only by passing through Ainsel River and the Lake of Rot and defeating Astel, Naturalborn of the Void. The lift which leads to the Moonlight Altar is sealed, and can only be accessed by obtaining the Dark Moon Ring from the treasure chest in Rennala's library in the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
The plateau, which sits above the Village of the Albinaurics, is the site of the Cathedral of Manus Celes, a large, ruined church. An Evergaol, housing the ringleader of the Black Knife Assassins, can also be found here.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Bring the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, who will give you the Carian Inverted Statue. This key item is required for Fia's questline, however it is not necessary to complete Ranni's questline.
WARNING: This will immediately end Preceptor Seluvis's quest.
Ainsel River
Renna's Rise will now be open after giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the sending gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.
Pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point and rest at the Ainsel River Main Site of Grace. Use the "Talk to miniature Ranni" option three times to get her to speak.
(Optional) Ranni will also have dialogue at the Nokstella, Eternal City and Nokstella Waterfall Basin Sites of Grace. These are not required to continue her questline.
Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to obtain the Discarded Palace Key. Go to Rennala's boss room in Academy of Raya Lucaria and unlock the chest to obtain the Dark Moon Ring.
Moonlight Altar
Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void at the end of the Lake of Rot and travel up the lift. This lift only unlocks if you have obtained the Dark Moon Ring.
Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and descend through the tunnel near the altar to find Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers. Interact with her to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, speak to her again and she will disappear, leaving behind the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Leyndell, Ashen Capital
After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign on the Stone Platform. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending.

(Optional) Church of Elleh
After meeting Melina and obtaining the Spectral Steed Whistle, use Torrent at least once. After that, rest on any Site of Grace. Ranni's Rise

Agree to become one of Ranni's vassals, and then head back down the tower to speak to the projections of Iji, Blaidd, and Seluvis. After speaking to all three, return to Ranni and speak to her again. After this point, if you return to Ranni she will be sleeping, and non-responsive.
Nokron, Eternal City
Nokron can only be accessed after defeating Radahn. Proceed through the area and obtain the Fingerslayer Blade, which is in a chest north-east of the Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace.

payload.title: Pidia, Carian Servant
payload.text:
Carian Manor
If Ranni the Witch has not been given either the Fingerslayer Blade OR Seluvis' Amber Draught, the player can find Pidia on the second floor of the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace. However, he can only be reached from the building's rooftop. To gain access to him, the player must travel to the Three Sisters and follow the clifftop above Caria Manor southwest. Once there, the player can descend several platforms in order to safely reach the Manor rooftop below. When first talking with Pidia, he will offer to sell you a number of rare items from his storeroom.
If Ranni the Witch has been given either the Fingerslayer Blade OR Seluvis' Amber Draught, the player will hear Pidia crying out in pain when approaching his location. Upon reaching him, the player will find Pidia lying dead, surrounded by the puppet soldiers he once maintained. The player can loot Pidia's Bell Bearing from his corpse, as well as one of two puppets depending upon certain conditions. If the player has already given Seluvis' Potion to Nepheli Loux, Pidia will drop the Nepheli Loux Puppet. If the player has not given Seluvis' Potion to Nepheli Loux, Pidia will drop Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet, instead.

sources.title: Moonveil
sources.text:
The Unique Skill: Transient Moonlight is the regular Skill: Unsheathe but with added projectiles: a short-ranged one for the light attack sweep and a mid-ranged one for the heavy attack overhead slash.
The skill is useful in roughly the same ways that Unsheathe is, meaning that the light attack follow-up is generally slightly quicker and much wider in exchange for being slightly weaker, while the heavy attack follow-up hits a single target slightly harder and is slightly more difficult to roll directly away from.
One stark difference is that the different attacks are much less dissimilar, with the light attack follow-up having less of a damage difference (22% less for Unsheathe, 10% less for Transient Moonlight) and much less of a Stance damage difference (50% less for Unsheathe, 8% less for Transient Moonlight).
While this does give the weapon some more reach (though mostly with the heavy attack follow-up), the skill is still the most effective at melee range since that means both the weapon and the magic waves can hit the target.
The skill's heavy attack follow-up has a weird interaction with jumping players and deals a lot less damage against them for some reason.
While a hybrid Intelligence/Dexterity build gains the highest total Attack Power a pure Intelligence build only loses about 2% total Attack Power in exchange for the skill's projectiles getting 13% higher Attack Power, making the latter generally preferable.

response.answer:
Với Samurai, Moonveil, level 100, PvE, hướng đi hợp lý là nghiêng hẳn về Intelligence thay vì chia đôi Int/Dex. Moonveil cần Strength 12, Dexterity 18 và Intelligence 23 để cầm một tay [3] — Samurai đã có sẵn Str 12, Dex 15 nên chỉ cần thêm 3 Dex và 14 Int là đủ điều kiện tối thiểu [5][3]. Kỹ năng Transient Moonlight của vũ khí này có sóng kiếm ăn theo Intelligence: build thuần Int mất khoảng 2% tổng Attack Power so với build lai Int/Dex, nhưng sóng kiếm lại mạnh hơn 13%, nên nhìn chung build thuần Int được đánh giá là lựa chọn tốt hơn [2].

Về cách chia điểm: ở level 100, tổng tám chỉ số của bạn phải bằng 179 (level + 79) [4], và Samurai xuất phát level 9 với Vigor 12, Mind 11, Endurance 13, Str 12, Dex 15, Int 9, Faith 8, Arcane 8 [5]. Nghĩa là bạn có 91 điểm cộng thêm để phân bổ, trong đó 17 điểm bắt buộc dành cho Dex/Int để đủ điều kiện cầm Moonveil [3][5]. Phần còn lại nên ưu tiên Vigor và một ít Endurance/Mind cho PvE, rồi dồn phần lớn vào Intelligence; Faith và Arcane có thể giữ nguyên mức khởi đầu [5][4].

Mình chưa thể đưa ra bảng phân bổ chính xác từng điểm (ví dụ Vigor bao nhiêu, Int bao nhiêu) vì thiếu quy tắc xác nhận về việc đổi lại chỉ số (respec) để đối chiếu.

Nếu bạn chưa đánh bại Starscourge Radahn thì chưa vào được Nokron — theo quest Ranni, Nokron chỉ mở sau khi Radahn bị hạ [2][3]. Khi Radahn đã chết, từ Mistwood hãy đi về phía nam tới một miệng hố lớn ở khu vực phía tây Fort Haight, rồi xuống bằng các bệ đá ở mặt đông của hố để tới Nokron, Eternal City [1].

Trên đường, để ý các xác có Golden Rune và hai Soporific Grease [1]. Việc ghé Forlorn Hound Evergaol hay đọc tin nhắn Blaidd để lại gần mép hố (đông-nam Mistwood Ruins) là các bước tùy chọn, không bắt buộc để vào Nokron [1]. Trong Nokron, mục tiêu của quest Ranni là lấy Fingerslayer Blade trong rương ở phía đông-bắc Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace [2].

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Completing Ranni's questline will unlock the Age of the Stars ending.
(Optional) Church of Elleh
After meeting Melina and obtaining the Spectral Steed Whistle, use Torrent at least once. After that, rest on any Site of Grace. Then, fast travel to the Church of Elleh Site of Grace and find Ranni (using the pseudonym "Renna") sitting on a broken wall. Exhaust her dialogue to receive the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.
If you miss this step, these items will be available for purchase at the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold -- 200 runes for the Lone Wolf Ashes and 1,000 runes for the Spirit Calling Bell respectively.
Ranni's Rise
Ranni can next be encountered on the top floor of Ranni's Rise, accessible by clearing Caria Manor. This stage varies depending on whether you have defeated her brother, Starscourge Radahn, or given Sorcerer Rogier the Black Knifeprint.
Agree to become one of Ranni's vassals, and then head back down the tower to speak to the projections of Iji, Blaidd, and Seluvis. After speaking to all three, return to Ranni and speak to her again. After this point, if you return to Ranni she will be sleeping, and non-responsive.
Nokron, Eternal City
Nokron can only be accessed after defeating Radahn. Proceed through the area and obtain the Fingerslayer Blade, which is in a chest north-east of the Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace.

sources.title: Walkthrough | Elden Ring Wiki
sources.text:
Upon completing Caria Manor, your next destination will be Ranni's Rise ( Elden Ring Map Link) but be wary since you may come across the Glintstone Dragon Adula, you don't have to fight this dragon, it's optional, and up to you. At Ranni's Rise, go all the way to the top and talk to Ranni the Witch to begin her questline: The Hidden Treasure of Nokron. Take her request and she will ask you to talk to three people who are in her service, these Are Seluvis, War Counselor Iji, and Blaidd who will appear in spectral form. These three will then appear in a spectral form on the first floor of her tower - talk to Ranni again after speaking to everyone to leave. [...] ### Nokron, Eternal City and Ranni's Quest

After defeating Rahdahn, you will now have access to Nokron, Eternal City. Follow the walkthrough on that page to procure the Fingerslayer Blade along the way. After finishing with Nokron, give Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade to continue with her quest, refer to Ranni the Witch page for more info. After giving her the blade, Renna's Rise will be opened and you can proceed to the next part of this walkthrough.

Completing Ranni's questline will unlock the Age of the Stars ending.
(Optional) Church of Elleh

Exhaust her dialogue to receive the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.

Ranni's Rise

Nokron, Eternal City
Nokron can only be accessed after defeating Radahn. Proceed through the area and obtain the Fingerslayer Blade, which is in a chest north-east of the Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace.

payload.title: Preceptor Seluvis
payload.text:
Pidia's questline becomes locked after giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade, regardless of any steps already completed.
Liurnia of the Lakes
Follow Ranni the Witch's questline and join her service in Ranni's Rise. Speak to the projections of Blaidd, Iji, and Seluvis, and then speak to Ranni once again.
Visit Seluvis's Rise, south of Ranni's Rise, and speak to Seluvis. Agree to his request to obtain Seluvis's Potion.
Perform any one of the following to proceed with Seluvis's questline:
Give Nepheli Loux the potion. In order to do this, you must have defeated the Omenkiller in the Village of the Albinaurics and Nepheli must be in the lower level of Roundtable Hold. You will obtain Nepheli Loux Puppet from Pidia, Carian Servant at the end of his questline.
Give Dung Eater the potion. In order to do this, you must have obtained a Seedbed Curse, freed Dung Eater from his gaol, defeated his dark spirit in the Capital Outskirts, and made sure Dung Eater has returned to his gaol. You will be able to Dung Eater Puppet from Seluvis after this.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir and give him the potion.
Return to Seluvis and exhaust his dialogue, regardless of the option chosen in the previous step. His shop inventory will now be available.
Travel to the ruins north-east of Ranni's Rise and pass through the illusory floor. Go down the steps into the cellar and interact with the message saying "Seluvis' puppet. Do not touch."

rows.question: Đã giao Fingerslayer Blade, đi đâu tiếp?
rows.expected_behavior: Retain Ranni topic, distinguish sending gate/Ainsel from optional statue use and Seluvis warning.

response.answer:
Sau khi giao Fingerslayer Blade, Renna's Rise sẽ mở. Bạn vào đó, leo lên trên và đi qua cổng gửi (sending gate) tới phần trên của Ainsel River. Nhặt Miniature Ranni gần điểm xuất hiện, nghỉ ở Site of Grace Ainsel River Main rồi dùng tùy chọn "Talk to miniature Ranni" ba lần để cô ấy nói chuyện [3].

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Bring the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, who will give you the Carian Inverted Statue. This key item is required for Fia's questline, however it is not necessary to complete Ranni's questline.
WARNING: This will immediately end Preceptor Seluvis's quest.
Ainsel River
Renna's Rise will now be open after giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the sending gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.
Pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point and rest at the Ainsel River Main Site of Grace. Use the "Talk to miniature Ranni" option three times to get her to speak.
(Optional) Ranni will also have dialogue at the Nokstella, Eternal City and Nokstella Waterfall Basin Sites of Grace. These are not required to continue her questline.
Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to obtain the Discarded Palace Key. Go to Rennala's boss room in Academy of Raya Lucaria and unlock the chest to obtain the Dark Moon Ring.
Moonlight Altar
Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void at the end of the Lake of Rot and travel up the lift. This lift only unlocks if you have obtained the Dark Moon Ring.
Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and descend through the tunnel near the altar to find Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers. Interact with her to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, speak to her again and she will disappear, leaving behind the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Leyndell, Ashen Capital
After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign on the Stone Platform. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending.

sources.title: Preceptor Seluvis
sources.text:
Return to Seluvis and select the "About your chambers" dialogue option. You will now be able to buy puppets from Seluvis in return for Starlight Shards. Buy any one of these puppets to continue.
Speak to Seluvis again and select the "About the scheme" dialogue option.
Obtain the Amber Starlight from Altus Plateau. This can be found in a small grotto north-east of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace, north of the giant staircase that leads to the Tree Sentinel boss fight.
Return to Seluvis and select the "Give Amber Starlight" dialogue option to obtain the Magic Scorpion Charm.
Reload the area and speak to Seluvis to obtain the Amber Draught.
You may attempt to give the Amber Draught to Ranni. Doing so will lock Ranni's questline, and it can only be resumed by seeking Absolution at the Church of Vows. Talking to her three times after trying to give her the draught will cause her to instantly kill you.
Seluvis will now be dead. His Bell bearing and armour set can be looted from his body, which can also be interacted with to access the puppet shop. Pidia will also die at this stage.
If Ranni is not given the Amber Draught, Seluvis will die in the same way after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade.

payload.title: War Counselor Iji
payload.text:
A good-natured troll who once served the Carian Royal Family as a blacksmith. Currently, Iji serves Ranni, the Carian princess, as her war counsellor, while still plying his trade as a blacksmith outside the Kingsrealm Ruins, near the Caria Manor.
Iji has known Ranni and Blaidd since they were children, and they would let him join in when they played. Along with Blaidd, he swore allegiance to Ranni when she renounced her flesh and chose the dark path of the Empyrean. Iji is also shown to care for Blaidd, however he also harbours some reservations. Fearing that, as her sworn shadow, Blaidd will go mad and become a curse for Ranni for resisting the Two Fingers, Iji imprisons Blaidd in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol.
Iji became acquainted with Jerren when he was a guest of the Carians. Jerren recalls that the weapons Iji smithed were blunt, yet did not decay when faced with Scarlet Rot. Jerren may also offer a vital clue regarding Ranni's fate, which helps Iji to come to the realisation that General Radahn must be killed in order to release the stars and Ranni's own fate.
Later, after Blaidd breaks free of his imprisonment and gives his life in defence of Ranni, Iji admits that he misjudged Blaidd's loyalty, and senses that he will soon join Blaidd in death. Later, he can be found dead, his body ablaze with black flame, with the corpses of Black Knife Assassins nearby.

payload.title: Erdtree Seal

Does NOT increase the damage of Erdtree Incantations, despite the name and association with that incantation type.
The strongest Faith-only Sacred Seal when the stat is above 68.

At maximum upgrade level it has 212 Incantation Scaling at 40 Faith (minimum requirement) and 353 Incantation Scaling at 80 Faith.

WARNING: This will immediately end Preceptor Seluvis's quest.
Ainsel River
Renna's Rise will now be open after giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the sending gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.

Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void at the end of the Lake of Rot and travel up the lift. This lift only unlocks if you have obtained the Dark Moon Ring.
Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and descend through the tunnel near the altar to find Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers. Interact with her to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, speak to her again and she will disappear, leaving behind the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Leyndell, Ashen Capital
After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign on the Stone Platform. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending.

sources.title: Moonveil
sources.text:
The Unique Skill: Transient Moonlight is the regular Skill: Unsheathe but with added projectiles: a short-ranged one for the light attack sweep and a mid-ranged one for the heavy attack overhead slash.
The skill is useful in roughly the same ways that Unsheathe is, meaning that the light attack follow-up is generally slightly quicker and much wider in exchange for being slightly weaker, while the heavy attack follow-up hits a single target slightly harder and is slightly more difficult to roll directly away from.
One stark difference is that the different attacks are much less dissimilar, with the light attack follow-up having less of a damage difference (22% less for Unsheathe, 10% less for Transient Moonlight) and much less of a Stance damage difference (50% less for Unsheathe, 8% less for Transient Moonlight).
While this does give the weapon some more reach (though mostly with the heavy attack follow-up), the skill is still the most effective at melee range since that means both the weapon and the magic waves can hit the target.
The skill's heavy attack follow-up has a weird interaction with jumping players and deals a lot less damage against them for some reason.
While a hybrid Intelligence/Dexterity build gains the highest total Attack Power a pure Intelligence build only loses about 2% total Attack Power in exchange for the skill's projectiles getting 13% higher Attack Power, making the latter generally preferable.

The base Magic Attack Power of the magic projectiles scale with user Intelligence and weapon upgrade level.
The scaling is greatly increased by Moonveil's default Intelligence-scaling.
The Attack Power (AP) for the light attack follow-up's magic projectile is always at least 560 for a weapon at maximum upgrade level, while for the strong attack follow-up's projectile it's always at least 620 for the same situation.
At +10 and with 23 Intelligence the magic wave's Attack Power is 821 for the light attack version and 908 for the strong attack version, with 45 Intelligence it's 1004 AP and 1111 AP respectively, and with 80 Intelligence it's 1135 AP and 1257 AP respectively.
Both follow-up attacks can be parried, and the waves of light can be spell-parried.
